children: may test support at $101.77 per barrel, a break below which may trigger a fall into the $98.44-$99.47 range.
A projection analysis of wave c from $95.12 shows resistance at $103.82, the 100% level, which triggered a deep correction on October 1.
The barrier may cause the second correction. A break above $103.82 could lead to a gain into the $105.09-$105.88 range. On the daily continuous chart
, a hanging man formed on Oct. 2, signalling a completion of the bounce from $96.55.
The contract may retrace toward this low. Signals would turn bullish if the market closes above $102.67 on Monday.
